verdict.rationale: Pipedream's error-handling docs say workflows can automatically retry events that yield an error, which targets transient API failures. That delivers the core retry capability. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable backoff, retry counts, or per-step retry settings. missing for 10: documented backoff strategy/configuration, configurable retry count or per-step retry policy, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities

citations.quote: You can automatically retry events that yield an error. This can help for transient errors that occur when making API requests, like when a service is down or your request times out.
